cases.testName: V2 control is request-scoped exact-argument-bound and single-use
cases.expected: Ordinary model requests cannot see or invoke the mutating Goal control; an authorized /goal request binds exact raw arguments once, so changed or replayed tool input fails before storage mutation.

cases.testName: V2 Plan can define a persisted Goal Contract but cannot activate it
cases.expected: The experimental V2 adapter persists the schema-v1 Goal Contract but keeps Plan paused; only an explicit Build resume activates and repins execution.

cases.testName: unsupported V2 parity-sensitive controls are explicit and never mutate live Goal state
cases.expected: A V2 control without stable parity refuses explicitly and leaves the exact live Goal snapshot unchanged.

cases.testName: V2 request hook injects persisted state and pauses an active Goal selected through Plan
cases.expected: Persisted Goal state reaches the current V2 model request while Plan remains a hard execution boundary and mutating Goal control stays hidden from ordinary requests.

cases.testName: V2 adapter fails closed when the session workspace cannot be resolved
cases.expected: Missing V2 session location.directory prevents all Goal storage access instead of falling back to an unrelated process working directory.
